policy.reason: OCR linear scales require review until the independent M12 gate

reasons: scale anchors must be strictly monotonic

sample_position_convention: first top/left pixel = 0; last bottom/right pixel = 1; no axial inset; transverse central-half sampling
ocr_coordinate_frame: raw tokens in upscaled crop; tick/text boxes in original image
limitations: Line residuals and OCR confidence do not certify tick values, biological meaning, original counts or measurement uncertainty.
